newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow in the panhandle area late Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested at the close.

Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 600 slaughter steers and 2,200 heifers; 25,700 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 19,900 head of formulated cattle, 600 previously contracted cattle and 700 head or 19 loads of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants.
Steers - few pens select and choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs
